key_risks.title: Pure-play renewables book stack
key_risks.body: GCube under Tokio Marine GX writes exclusively wind, solar, hydro and BESS property/operational cover — book concentration 4/4. Shared weather and grid geographies drive aggregation/correlation 3/4; a regional low-wind or constraint event can hit multiple cedants in the same quarter. Tokio Marine capital (4/4) absorbs individual losses but correlated curtailment is not a separate PML line.

key_risks.title: One parametric line, PD/BI core
key_risks.body: Disclosed non-damage product count n=1 → trigger_gap 3/4. Core renewables binder remains indemnity PD/BI; grid curtailment and availability without physical damage fall outside primary wordings. Product fit 2/4 vs parametric-native MGAs — close via trigger_mining on operational BI clauses.

Intermittent generation clients face basis risk when grid firmness drops without PD.

key_risks.body: Tokio Marine Group balance-sheet backing (capital 3/4) replaced third-party carrier paper post-acquisition, but pricing methodology is not publicly disclosed (2/4). Long-dated asset lives vs annual operational programmes (tenor mismatch 2/4) leave tail curtailment scenarios under-modelled without UK register fusion.

key_risks.body: Howden's Aviva-led Lloyd's-accredited renewables facility (up to £150m per declaration) concentrates UK wind/solar cedants across hub offices — book concentration 3/4 with partial aggregation 2/4. key_risks.title: Damage facility vs parametric desk
key_risks.body: Core renewables facilities remain legacy damage-based BI, while Howden separately brokers parametric/non-damage cover (Instech case study) — trigger_gap 2/4. Clients on the £150m facility without a parametric top-up face absent availability and BI-without-damage triggers when curtailment hits without PD.

key_risks.title: Advisory data, no grid telemetry
key_risks.body: 160+ natural-resources specialists and due-diligence analytics (underwriting 4/4) but no proprietary grid telemetry — data monitoring 2/4. Multi-year project lifecycles vs annual placement (tenor mismatch 2/4) push curtailment modelling burden to carriers; close via register_pull on facility cedant ECR/TEC rows.

key_risks.body: Kettle's parametric wildfire reinsurance book scores aggregation/correlation 4/4 — the batch maximum — on correlated satellite/ML wildfire index triggers across US west portfolios. This is peril-specific clustering, not UK grid geography; the spike does not translate to NESO constraint correlation.

key_risks.body: Book concentration and non-firm intensity both 0/4 — no evidenced UK power, DC or renewables cedant stack. Kettle is whitespace on the NFRI index: parametric-native (trigger_gap 0/4 disclosed n=0 wildfire products on site) but wrong peril and geography for UK curtailment underwriting.
